rationale: The agent cancelled the order without first authenticating the user, did not confirm the cancellation prior to executing a write, and did not attempt the user’s stated preferences (split payment, remove most expensive item, switch to cheapest options) before resorting to cancellation. The final message asserts a refund timeline without tool-backed support. These actions violate the policy requirements to authenticate, confirm before order-changing writes, and provide correct, supported information. Therefore, the conversation fails the pass bar.
